headline: Anthropic shares reported down 9% on Friday after Nasdaq debut
body: CNBC says Anthropic shares fell 9% on Friday after a historic Nasdaq debut, as concerns about the AI trade continued to drag tech stocks lower. The stock opened at $111.50 on Thursday and closed at $97.17.
note: Investors had been eagerly awaiting the debut in the hope that it could revitalize the AI trade, CNBC says. Nvidia and AMD were also trading lower.

figure.label: Anthropic share move on Friday, per CNBC

evidence.text: Anthropic shares fell 9% on Friday after a historic Nasdaq debut, as concerns about artificial intelligence trade continued to drag tech stocks lower.
The stock opened at $111.50 on the Nasdaq Thursday after Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in the largest IPO of all time, but shares slid throughout the day and closed at $97.17.
Investors had been eagerly awaiting Anthropic's debut in the hopes that it could revitalize the AI trade, which has come under pressure.
Nvidia and AMD were also trading lower.

correction: CNBC rewrote its article after publication: the figures first cited (premarket -5.6%, Nvidia -1.66%, AMD -4.12%, +17% first day) are no longer on the page. Rewritten to the current text (-9% Friday, opened $111.50, closed $97.17 Thursday).
